notes: Colloquial masculine تعبان (ta'ban) agrees with the speaker; feminine تعبانة. Pan-dialectal form used across Saudi varieties (MSA uses متعب).
Colloquial masculine فرحان (farhan); feminine فرحانة (farhana). Common across Saudi and Gulf varieties; the fa'lan adjective pattern also exists in Classical Arabic.
Colloquial feminine تعبانة (ta'bana) agrees with the speaker; masculine تعبان (ta'ban).
Masculine تعبان agrees with the third-person subject هو (he), not the speaker; the speaker's gender is unknown.
Feminine فرحانة agrees with the third-person subject هي (she); no first-person gender marking.
